timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹253.08 Cr (-34.6% YoY), net profit ₹5.72 Cr (-83.5% YoY).
Vascon Engineers reported an investor presentation for May 2026 highlighting an FY26 total order book of ₹2,717 Cr.
Vascon Engineers Limited hosted an Analyst Meet on May 13, 2026, sharing Audited Financial Results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
Vascon Engineers received a ₹131.58 Cr work order from Reliance Industries for construction at Jamnagar.
Vascon Engineers held an EGM on May 18, 2026, passing special resolutions for warrant issuance and borrowing powers.
Vascon Engineers received a ₹198 Cr Letter of Acceptance from State Bank of India for construction work in Hinjewadi, Pune.
